name: Chinese section-mold bronze casting
summary: Northern Chinese foundries cast hollow bronze vessels in clay moulds made in removable sections around a clay core, a distinctive way of making elaborate bronzes.
description: Hollow bronze vessels cast using removable clay section molds around a ceramic core.
